meta.title: The superpower probe loop: hats, real code, isolation probe, guardrail

states.label: Isolation probe
states.sublabel: run the real API on real files

cards.title: The four steps that must not be skipped
items: Hats first: the round is analysed from six angles before any file is touched
Then C1–C10 are implemented for real — a stub does not count as done
Then the isolation probe runs the real API on real files, outside the repo
Only then is the finding locked into a registry guardrail

cards.title: Why the probe comes before the guardrail
items: A guard written from a guess freezes the guess
The probe's own self-test must pass before its numbers are trusted
A measurement tool's own bug fabricates bugs in the thing being measured

cards.title: Where each round ends
items: A green full-regression against the baseline closes the round
The round ends with next-round candidates C'1–C'10, not with a summary
'Passed once' is not accepted as 'repeatable' — the probe is run again
